findings.evidence: Line 94 `((⟨s, hs0⟩ : P.ringOfDefinition) ^ n) • y = x` versus line 120 `hz : s ^ k • z ∈ M₀` and Basic.lean:530 `fun n ↦ (a ^ n) • (P.ringOfDefinition : Set A)`.
findings.fix: Add the `A`-side characterisation and make it the `@[simp]` form: `smul_mem_powSmulFamily : y ∈ M₀ → s ^ n • y ∈ P.powSmulFamily hs0 M₀ n` plus `mem_powSmulFamily : x ∈ P.powSmulFamily hs0 M₀ n ↔ ∃ y ∈ M₀, s ^ n • y = x` (or `coe_powSmulFamily : ↑(P.powSmulFamily hs0 M₀ n) = s ^ n • (M₀ : Set M)`); the file's own line 195 shows the two forms are definitionally equal.
findings.issue: `mem_powSmulFamily` (and `powSmulFamily_def:82`) characterise the family only via `(⟨s, hs0⟩ : P.ringOfDefinition) ^ n • y`, whereas `pow_add_smul_mem:119`, `exists_pow_smul_mem:135` and upstream `IsPseudoUniformizer.hasBasis_nhds_zero` (Basic.lean:528) all speak in `s ^ n` with `s : A`. With the body unexposed, a downstream user has no route from an `A`-side power into the family without redoing the `change`/`push_cast` plumbing this file does internally at lines 127, 160 and 188.

findings.evidence: Full read of the file: the only declarations are `powSmulFamily`, `powSmulFamily_def`, `mem_powSmulFamily`, `powSmulFamily_antitone`, `exists_pow_mul_mem`, `pow_add_smul_mem`, `exists_pow_smul_mem`, `powSmulFamily_smul`, `powSmulFamily_submodulesBasis`; no `_zero` or `_succ`.

findings.issue: No lemma gives the value of the family at `0`; `M₀` itself being a member of the family — the base case of Wedhorn's fundamental system — is not stated, and a consumer cannot get it without unfolding the unexposed body.

findings.evidence: Line 216 `smul m i := P.powSmulFamily_smul hs hs0 M₀ hspan m i`; Mathlib Bases.lean:242 declares the field as `smul : ∀ (m : M) (i : ι), ∀ᶠ a in 𝓝 (0 : R), a • m ∈ B i`, the same statement.
findings.fix: Mark it `private`; the structure instance at line 216 can still consume it. (Keep `powSmulFamily_antitone` public — it is strictly stronger than the `inter` field.)
findings.issue: `powSmulFamily_smul` is exactly the `smul` field of `powSmulFamily_submodulesBasis`, under identical hypotheses, so it is a second public name for a fact already reachable as `(P.powSmulFamily_submodulesBasis hs hs0 M₀ hspan).smul m n`. It has no use outside this file.

summary: The characteristic membership API is stated only in A₀ subtype-constructor scalars while every neighbouring lemma uses A-side `s ^ n`, leaving no usable bridge for consumers; `powSmulFamily_zero` is missing, and `powSmulFamily_smul` duplicates the `smul` field of the basis.
